name: Betrayal
text: The person who has been helping you suddenly vanishes with your Objects. Each Dreamer Represses Objects from Hand equal to Willpower minus Lucidity.

name: Chase
text: Spawn 1 Encounter on each Dreamer-occupied Landscape. If Elasticity exceeds Willpower, you may escape; otherwise Meet is your only action this round.

name: Heroism
text: Bright: Discard 2 Willpower — every Dreamer draws 2 Psyche. Dim: Each Dreamer Represses 1 Object.

name: Injury
text: Bright: Discard 3 Lucidity — draw 1 Object. Dim: Each Dreamer Represses 2 Psyche.

name: Judgement
text: Bright: Each Dreamer Represses 3 Psyche — Return every Dreambeast from the Subconscious. Dim: Spawn 1 Dreambeast on each Dreamer's Landscape.

name: Loss
text: Bright: Discard 4 Willpower — Return 2 cards. Dim: Forget Sea of Teeth and Field of Broken Glass.

name: Misunderstanding
text: Bright: Discard 2 Lucidity — Reveal 1 Landscape. Dim: Repress 3 cards from the Lucidity Mindstream.

name: Mortality
text: Bright: Discard 3 Willpower — every Dreamer draws 1 Psyche. Dim: Each Dreamer Represses 2 Objects.

name: Abandonment
text: Repress all Active Encounters. Dreamers on the same Landscape move to adjacent empty Landscapes.

name: Abduction
text: Bright: Discard 2 Elasticity — gain 1 free Meet action. Dim: Forget The Attic and The Basement.

name: Absurdity
text: Bright: Discard 3 Elasticity — draw 2 Psyche. Dim: Forget Insanity and Black Void.

name: Bargaining
text: All Dreamers may Discard 6 Psyche to Acquire 1 Archetype matching their suit.

name: Recovery
text: Bright: Discard 2 Lucidity — every Dreamer Returns 1 card. Dim: Repress 3 cards from the Psyche deck.

name: Responsibility
text: Bright: Discard 3 Willpower — gain 1 Power Token. Dim: Forget Awards and The Party.

name: Travel
text: Next Explore Phase, each Dreamer may move anywhere for free. Cannot take Landscape Actions next Meet Phase.

name: Wanderlust
text: If Dreamers Explore a total of three times player count Landscapes this round, all Dreamers Draw 3 Psyche.

name: Transformation
text: Bright: Discard 2 Willpower — draw 1 Object. Dim: Repress 2 cards from the Willpower Mindstream.

name: Trapped
text: Skip the next Explore Phase.

name: Lost
text: Bright: Discard 3 Lucidity — Reveal 2 Landscapes. Dim: Forget Endless Ocean and Lava.

name: Misplaced
text: Bright: Discard 2 Elasticity — Return 1 Object. Dim: Each Dreamer Represses 1 Object.

name: Rivalry
text: Draw 1 Encounter per 2 Players and place them on The Bed. Leftover Encounters cost 1 Psyche each at end of Meet.

name: Temptation
text: All Dreamers may discard up to 3 Objects to Draw that many Psyche.

name: Powerlessness
text: Bright: Discard 4 Willpower — gain 1 free Meet action. Dim: Forget Tranquil Grove and Endless Hallway.

name: Well Being
text: Bright: Discard 2 Lucidity — every Dreamer draws 2 Psyche. Dim: Each Dreamer Represses 1 Psyche.

name: Quiet
text: Bright: Discard 1 Lucidity — gain 1 Power Token. Dim: Repress 3 cards from the Elasticity Mindstream.

name: Delta
text: Bright: Discard 2 Elasticity — every Dreamer draws 1 Psyche. Dim: Forget Desert and Silver Mist.

name: Beta
text: Bright: Discard 3 Willpower — gain 1 Power Token. Dim: Each Dreamer Represses 2 Psyche.

name: Circadia
text: Bright: Discard 3 Lucidity — every Dreamer Returns 1 card. Dim: Repress 4 cards from the Psyche deck.

name: Somnambulance
text: Bright: Discard 2 Elasticity — the next Explore is free. Dim: Forget Candy Mountain and Scary Classroom.

name: Homeostasis
text: Draw 5 Psyche.

name: Pineal Purge
text: Bright: Discard 4 Lucidity — Return 3 cards. Dim: Repress 1 card from each Mindstream.
